tool_input.command: grep -ln "מיון" machtzev/generator/specs-ds/*.txt machtzev/generator/app-golden*.json 2>/dev/null; echo "--- specs with time label and sort ---"; grep -l "שעה" machtzev/generator/specs-ds/*.txt | xargs grep -l "מיון" 2>/dev/null; echo "--- regen sechirut + peruk with sort (byte-check) ---"; for ns in $(grep -ln "מיון" machtzev/generator/specs-ds/*.txt | xargs -n1 basename | sed 's/.txt//' | grep -v calendar); do node machtzev/generator/app-ds.mjs -f machtzev/generator/specs-ds/$ns.txt --name $ns --skin >/dev/null 2>&1; echo "$ns: $(git status --short | grep -c "_$ns\_\|plan-$ns") changed files"; done
tool_input.description: Find other specs using sort and regenerate them to confirm the comparator change is byte-identical for them

result:
Done. Meetings in the calendar app now sort by `שעה` on both the entity list screen and a new particle-screen table.

**What changed**
- `machtzev/generator/specs-ds/calendar.txt`: added `| מיון: שעה עולה` to the entity line, and a new particle line `חלקיק פגישה: פגישות = [טבלה] | מיון: שעה עולה`. The spec had no particle screen before, so this creates it using the existing table-with-sort grammar.
- `machtzev/generator/sort-cmp.mjs`: the shared comparator emitter now recognises time-labelled fields and compares `H:MM` values as minutes. Without this, `9:00` sorted after `16:30` lexically. All other field kinds emit byte-identical code.
- Regenerated the calendar app. The entity screen sorts the record list before the list, board, calendar and table views branch. The new `gen_app_calendar_px1.dart` table sorts its rows the same way, and the hub gained a nav tile to it.

**How I verified it** (Flutter and Dart are not installed, so no compile)
- Regenerating unchanged before editing produced zero diff, so every diff is from this change.
- Both generated sort keys resolve to the constant `'שעה'`.
- A JS mirror of the emitted comparator orders sample rows correctly, empty times last.
- The five other specs that use sorting regenerate with zero diff.
- Gates green: particles, balagan-look, balagan-one, spec-lang-doc.
- `police --fast` has four red gates, all pre-existing from the HEAD commit or the clone (unrefreshed pins and TRUTH.md, INDEX.md entries, missing git blobs). None involve files I touched.

The report is at `_report.md`. Nothing was committed.
